-- Kidnap Command & Control GUI Script (Fixed Throttling & Teleport Sequence)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local DEFAULT_MODEL_ID = 3544143040

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- F3X Endpoint Resolver
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function GetF3X()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local tool = (char and (char:FindFirstChild("Building Tools") or char:FindFirstChild("F3X"))) 
        or (backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Building Tools") or backpack:FindFirstChild("F3X")))
    
    if tool then
        local syncAPI = tool:FindFirstChild("SyncAPI") or tool:FindFirstChild("SyncApi")
        if syncAPI then
            local endpoint = syncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerEndpoint") or syncAPI:FindFirstChild("ServerControl")
            if endpoint then return endpoint end
        end
        for _, desc in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("RemoteFunction") or desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return desc
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function MapPartType(part)
    if part:IsA("WedgePart") then return "Wedge" end
    if part:IsA("CornerWedgePart") then return "Corner" end
    if part:IsA("TrussPart") then return "Truss" end
    if part:IsA("Part") then
        if part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then return "Sphere" end
        if part.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then return "Cylinder" end
    end
    return "Normal"
end

local function SafeGetObjects(id)
    local loaded = false
    local result = nil
    
    task.spawn(function()
        local success, raw = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)) end)
        if success and raw and #raw > 0 then
            result = raw[1]
        end
        loaded = true
    end)
    
    local timeWaited = 0
    while not loaded and timeWaited < 8 do
        task.wait(0.05)
        timeWaited += 0.05
    end
    
    return result
end

local function GetContainerBoundingBox(object)
    if object:IsA("Model") then
        local success, cf, size = pcall(function() return object:GetBoundingBox() end)
        if success and cf and size then
            return cf, size
        end
    elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
        return object.CFrame, object.Size
    end
    
    local parts = {}
    for _, desc in ipairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, desc)
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        return CFrame.new(), Vector3.new(4, 1, 2)
    end
    
    local minX, minY, minZ = math.huge, math.huge, math.huge
    local maxX, maxY, maxZ = -math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge
    
    for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
        local cf = part.CFrame
        local size = part.Size
        local pmin = cf.Position - size/2
        local pmax = cf.Position + size/2
        minX = math.min(minX, pmin.X); minY = math.min(minY, pmin.Y); minZ = math.min(minZ, pmin.Z)
        maxX = math.max(maxX, pmax.X); maxY = math.max(maxY, pmax.Y); maxZ = math.max(maxZ, pmax.Z)
    end
    
    local center = Vector3.new((minX + maxX)/2, (minY + maxY)/2, (minZ + maxZ)/2)
    local size = Vector3.new(maxX - minX, maxY - minY, maxZ - minZ)
    return CFrame.new(center), size
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Fast Parallel Asset Import
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function FastImportModel(endpoint, modelId, spawnCFrame)
    local rootObject = SafeGetObjects(modelId)
    if not rootObject then return nil, {}, {}, {} end

    local boundingCFrame = GetContainerBoundingBox(rootObject)
    local partsToImport = {}

    if rootObject:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(partsToImport, rootObject) end
    for _, child in ipairs(rootObject:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(partsToImport, child) end
    end

    if #partsToImport == 0 then
        rootObject:Destroy()
        return nil, {}, {}, {}
    end

    local createdF3XParts = {}
    local primaryPart = nil
    local doorParts = {}
    local createdMap = {}

    local pending = #partsToImport
    local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

    for idx, part in ipairs(partsToImport) do
        task.spawn(function()
            local targetCFrame = spawnCFrame * boundingCFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
            local partType = MapPartType(part)
            
            local ok, createdPart = pcall(function()
                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    return endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", partType, targetCFrame, workspace)
                else
                    endpoint:FireServer("CreatePart", partType, targetCFrame, workspace)
                end
            end)
            
            if ok and createdPart then
                createdMap[idx] = { Instance = createdPart, Original = part, TargetCFrame = targetCFrame }
            end

            pending -= 1
            if pending <= 0 then
                bindable:Fire()
            end
        end)
    end

    if pending > 0 then
        bindable.Event:Wait()
    end
    bindable:Destroy()

    local resizeBatch, colorBatch, matBatch, anchorBatch, collisionBatch = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local createMeshesBatch, syncMeshBatch = {}, {}

    for idx = 1, #partsToImport do
        if createdMap[idx] then
            local c = createdMap[idx].Instance
            local p = createdMap[idx].Original
            local t = createdMap[idx].TargetCFrame

            table.insert(createdF3XParts, c)
            if not primaryPart or p.Name == "Primary" or p.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or p.Name == "Body" then
                primaryPart = c
            end

            if string.find(string.lower(p.Name), "door") then
                table.insert(doorParts, c)
            end

            table.insert(resizeBatch, { Part = c, CFrame = t, Size = p.Size })
            table.insert(colorBatch, { Part = c, Color = p.Color })
            table.insert(matBatch, { Part = c, Material = p.Material, Transparency = p.Transparency })
            table.insert(anchorBatch, { Part = c, Anchored = true })
            table.insert(collisionBatch, { Part = c, CanCollide = false })

            if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
                table.insert(createMeshesBatch, { Part = c })
                table.insert(syncMeshBatch, {
                    Part = c,
                    MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh,
                    MeshId = p.MeshId,
                    TextureId = p.TextureID or "",
                    Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
                })
            end

            for _, descendant in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                if descendant:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    table.insert(createMeshesBatch, { Part = c })
                    table.insert(syncMeshBatch, {
                        Part = c,
                        MeshType = descendant.MeshType,
                        MeshId = descendant.MeshId,
                        TextureId = descendant.TextureId,
                        Scale = descendant.Scale,
                        Offset = descendant.Offset,
                        VertexColor = descendant.VertexColor
                    })
                elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") or descendant:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                    pcall(function()
                        local clone = descendant:Clone()
                        clone.Parent = c
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function SendBatch(method, batch)
        if #batch == 0 then return end
        local chunkSize = 200
        for i = 1, #batch, chunkSize do
            local chunk = {}
            for j = i, math.min(i + chunkSize - 1, #batch) do
                table.insert(chunk, batch[j])
            end
            pcall(function()
                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    endpoint:InvokeServer(method, chunk)
                else
                    endpoint:FireServer(method, chunk)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    SendBatch("SyncResize", resizeBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncColor", colorBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncAnchor", anchorBatch)
    SendBatch("SyncCollision", collisionBatch)
    if #createMeshesBatch > 0 then SendBatch("CreateMeshes", createMeshesBatch) end
    if #syncMeshBatch > 0 then SendBatch("SyncMesh", syncMeshBatch) end

    primaryPart = primaryPart or createdF3XParts[1]

    local partOffsets = {}
    if primaryPart then
        local primaryStartCF = primaryPart.CFrame
        for _, part in ipairs(createdF3XParts) do
            partOffsets[part] = primaryStartCF:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
        end
    end

    rootObject:Destroy()
    return primaryPart, createdF3XParts, partOffsets, doorParts
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Target Resolver (Prefix / First-Letter Match)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getTargets(arg)
    if not arg or arg == "" then return {LocalPlayer} end
    arg = string.lower(arg)

    if arg == "me" then
        return {LocalPlayer}
    elseif arg == "all" then
        return Players:GetPlayers()
    elseif arg == "others" then
        local matched = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(matched, p) end
        end
        return matched
    end

    local matched = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = string.lower(p.Name)
        local disp = string.lower(p.DisplayName)
        
        if string.sub(name, 1, #arg) == arg or string.sub(disp, 1, #arg) == arg or string.find(name, arg, 1, true) or string.find(disp, arg, 1, true) then
            table.insert(matched, p)
        end
    end
    return matched
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core Kidnap Execution
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function executeKidnap(targetPlayer, modelId, driveDistance, moveSpeed)
    task.spawn(function()
        local endpoint = GetF3X()
        if not endpoint then
            warn("Kidnap Error: F3X Building Tools not found!")
            return
        end

        local char = targetPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end

        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local isLocal = (targetPlayer == LocalPlayer)

        if torso and humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
            humanoid.JumpPower = 0
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false

            local tPos = torso.CFrame
            local approachDist = math.clamp(driveDistance * 0.4, 200, 1000)
            local spawnPos = tPos * (CFrame.new(-approachDist, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            local primary, allParts, offsets, doorParts = FastImportModel(endpoint, modelId, spawnPos)
            if not primary or #allParts == 0 then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                return
            end

            local function check()
                return targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players and torso and humanoid and torso.Parent and humanoid.Parent and char and char.Parent
            end

            local sound, chuckle
            if isLocal then
                sound = Instance.new("Sound", primary)
                sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://532147820"
                sound.Looped = true
                sound:Play()

                chuckle = Instance.new("Sound", primary)
                chuckle.SoundId = "rbxassetid://109527445730513"
                chuckle.Looped = true
                chuckle.Volume = 0.25
                chuckle:Play()
            end

            local function SetDoorTransparency(transparencyValue)
                if #doorParts > 0 then
                    local matBatch = {}
                    for _, dPart in ipairs(doorParts) do
                        table.insert(matBatch, { Part = dPart, Material = dPart.Material, Transparency = transparencyValue })
                    end
                    pcall(function()
                        if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
                        else
                            endpoint:FireServer("SyncMaterial", matBatch)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            -- Throttled Drive Loop (20Hz Server Network Update Rate)
            local function SmoothThrottledDrive(startCF, targetCF, speed)
                local dist = (targetCF.Position - startCF.Position).Magnitude
                local duration = math.max(0.2, dist / speed)
                local startTime = os.clock()
                local lastNetworkSend = 0
                local sendInterval = 0.05 -- 20 FPS network sync rate to prevent server throttling
                local thread = coroutine.running()
                local conn

                conn = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                    if not check() then
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        task.spawn(thread)
                        return
                    end

                    local now = os.clock()
                    local elapsed = now - startTime
                    local alpha = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
                    local currentCF = startCF:Lerp(targetCF, alpha)

                    -- Update server positions at 20Hz interval
                    if (now - lastNetworkSend) >= sendInterval or alpha >= 1 then
                        lastNetworkSend = now
                        local batchMove = {}
                        for part, offsetCF in pairs(offsets) do
                            table.insert(batchMove, { Part = part, CFrame = currentCF * offsetCF })
                        end

                        task.spawn(function()
                            pcall(function()
                                if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                    endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMove", batchMove)
                                else
                                    endpoint:FireServer("SyncMove", batchMove)
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                    end

                    if alpha >= 1 then
                        conn:Disconnect()
                        task.spawn(thread)
                    end
                end)

                coroutine.yield()
            end

            -- Drive Approach Phase
            local approachStartCF = spawnPos
            local approachTargetCF = tPos * (CFrame.new(0, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            SmoothThrottledDrive(approachStartCF, approachTargetCF, moveSpeed)

            if sound then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.9 end
            task.wait(0.1)
            if check() then SetDoorTransparency(1) end
            task.wait(0.2)

            -- Lock Player Inside Vehicle
            local activeWeld = nil
            local lockConnection = nil

            if check() then
                local vehicleInsideCF = primary.CFrame * (CFrame.new(0, 2.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
                
                if isLocal then
                    torso.Anchored = true
                    torso.CFrame = vehicleInsideCF

                    lockConnection = RunService.PreRender:Connect(function()
                        if check() and primary and primary.Parent then
                            torso.CFrame = primary.CFrame * (CFrame.new(0, 2.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0))
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                            if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                                endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {{ Part = torso, Anchored = false }})
                                endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateWelds", { primary }, torso)
                            else
                                endpoint:FireServer("SyncAnchor", {{ Part = torso, Anchored = false }})
                                endpoint:FireServer("CreateWelds", { primary }, torso)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    torso.CFrame = vehicleInsideCF
                    activeWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    activeWeld.Part0 = primary
                    activeWeld.Part1 = torso
                    activeWeld.Parent = primary
                end
            end

            task.wait(0.2)
            if check() then SetDoorTransparency(0) end
            task.wait(0.2)

            if sound then sound.PlaybackSpeed = 1.3 end

            -- Drive Away Phase
            local driveAwayStartCF = approachTargetCF
            local driveAwayTargetCF = tPos * (CFrame.new(driveDistance, 0, -7) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(270), 0))

            SmoothThrottledDrive(driveAwayStartCF, driveAwayTargetCF, moveSpeed)

            if isLocal and targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
                pcall(function()
                    TeleportService:Teleport(131190128172062, targetPlayer)
                end)
            end

            task.wait(0.2)

            if lockConnection then lockConnection:Disconnect() end
            if isLocal and torso then torso.Anchored = false end
            if activeWeld then pcall(function() activeWeld:Destroy() end) end

            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if endpoint:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                        endpoint:InvokeServer("Remove", allParts)
                    else
                        endpoint:FireServer("Remove", allParts)
                    end
                end)
            end)

            pcall(function()
                if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Parent == Players then
                    if humanoid then
                        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                        humanoid.JumpPower = 50
                        humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local function SendChatMessage(message)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local textChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
        if textChannel then
            textChannel:SendAsync(message)
        end
    else
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(message, "All")
    end
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function GetNearestPlayerInFront(targetPlayer, maxAngle)
    maxAngle = maxAngle or 60

    if not targetPlayer.Character then return nil end
    local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return nil end

    local targetLook = targetHRP.CFrame.LookVector

    local closest = nil
    local closestDist = math.huge

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p ~= targetPlayer and p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local difference = hrp.Position - targetHRP.Position

                if difference.Magnitude > 0 then
                    local vec = difference.Unit
                    local dot = math.clamp(targetLook:Dot(vec), -1, 1)
                    local angle = math.deg(math.acos(dot))

                    if angle <= maxAngle then
                        local dist = difference.Magnitude

                        if dist < closestDist then
                            closestDist = dist
                            closest = hrp
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return closest
end

do
    local dragging = false
    local dragInput = nil
    local dragStart = nil
    local startPosition = nil

    local function updateDrag(input)
        if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPosition then
            return
        end

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then
            return
        end

        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

        local newX = startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local newY = startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y

        newX = math.clamp(
            newX,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
        )

        newY = math.clamp(
            newY,
            0,
            math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
        )

        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(newX, newY)
    end

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            local target = input.Target

            if target == closeBtn
                or target == guiToggle
                or target == targetBox
                or target == standBtn
                or target == punchBtn
                or target == posBox
                or target == offBox
                or target == heightBox then
                return
            end

            dragging = true
            dragInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = mainFrame.Position

            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                    dragInput = nil
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    mainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            dragInput = input
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput then
            updateDrag(input)
        end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if standOn and bp and gyro and targetBox.Text ~= "" then

        if vanished and savedCharacterCFrame then
            bp.Position = Vector3.new(
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.X,
                VANISH_HEIGHT,
                savedCharacterCFrame.Position.Z
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                bp.Position,
                bp.Position + savedCharacterCFrame.LookVector
            )

            return
        end

        floatTime += dt * 2
        local floatOffset = math.sin(floatTime) * 0.5

        local t = findTargetByName(targetBox.Text)

        if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local targetHRP = t.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local tcf = targetHRP.CFrame
            local desiredPos

            if blocking then
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    + tcf.LookVector * BLOCK_DISTANCE
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset, 0)
            else
                desiredPos =
                    tcf.Position
                    - tcf.LookVector * standDistance
                    + tcf.RightVector * sideOffset
                    + Vector3.new(0, heightOffset + floatOffset, 0)
            end

            bp.Position = bp.Position:Lerp(
                desiredPos,
                math.clamp(followSpeed, 0.01, 1)
            )

            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                humanoidRootPart.Position,
                humanoidRootPart.Position + tcf.LookVector
            )
        end
    end
end)

local function runPastebinStyleFling(duration)
    local start = tick()
    local movel = 0.1

    while tick() - start < duration do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local c = player.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000
                + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel
                + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

scripts.script:
--[[
	woodcarving_perfect.luau  —  BUILD 2026-10-04b
	Carve Wood (place 82712304391069): carves the log on your Wood Lathe to exactly
	the target shape → 100% accuracy.

	How it works (from the decompiled client):
	  • LatheController keeps Cylinder.Profile (your log) and AccuracyCalculator.TargetProfile
	    (the target). Accuracy = Progress × (1 − overcut penalty); every slice == target → 100.
	  • WoodCarving:CompleteLatheWork() sends SaveCarvedWood { Serialized = your log,
	    TargetSerialized = the client-generated target, ... }, so matching radii is all that counts.
	  • We cut the radii with Profile:SetRadius + Cylinder:UpdateSlices (same path the chisel
	    uses) and set HasModifiedWood so the game's own Confirm button works.

	Finding the lathe (no per-frame / periodic memory scans):
	  1. Hook LatheController.Update + WoodCarving.RenderStep through require() → the game hands
	     us `self` every frame for free.
	  2. Fallback if the hook never fires: ONE getgc pass when the lathe's "TargetGhostMesh"
	     appears (i.e. once per lathe entry), never on a timer.

	Usage: run it, sit at the lathe. Each log is carved down to the target over CARVE_SECONDS,
	then press the game's Confirm (or set AUTO_CONFIRM = true). Carve Next works too.
	Toggle on/off: TOGGLE_KEY.  Re-running the script replaces the old instance.
]]

local BUILD = "2026-10-04b"

-- ── config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local CFG = {
	CARVE_SECONDS = 6, -- time to cut a log from its current shape down to the target (0 = instant)
	STEP_HZ = 15, -- carve + mesh updates per second (lower = lighter on FPS, carving looks choppier)
	ONLY_REDUCE = true, -- true: never add wood back (like a real chisel). Slices you already
	--                     overcut stay overcut and are reported. false: also raise them to target.
	AUTO_CONFIRM = false, -- true: call the game's CompleteLatheWork() once a log hits 100%
	AUTO_CONFIRM_DELAY = 0.75, -- seconds to wait at 100% before auto-confirming
	TOGGLE_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket,
	VERBOSE = true,
}

local TAG = "[wcperfect " .. BUILD .. "]"
local function log(...)
	print(TAG, ...)
end
local function vlog(...)
	if CFG.VERBOSE then
		print(TAG, ...)
	end
end

-- stop a previous run
local G = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if G.__WCPerfect and G.__WCPerfect.Stop then
	pcall(G.__WCPerfect.Stop)
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local state = {
	Enabled = true,
	Lathe = nil, -- LatheController instance
	Carving = nil, -- WoodCarving client instance (owns CompleteLatheWork)
	Piece = nil, -- per-workpiece bookkeeping
	Accum = 0,
	LastHookCall = 0,
	Conns = {},
	Unhooks = {},
}

-- ── carve logic ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function getProfiles(lathe)
	if lathe.Destroyed or lathe.WoodTransition ~= nil then
		return nil
	end
	local cyl = lathe.Cylinder
	local calc = lathe.AccuracyCalculator
	if type(cyl) ~= "table" or cyl.Destroyed or type(calc) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local cur = cyl.Profile
	local tgt = calc.TargetProfile
	if type(tgt) == "table" and tgt.Profile then
		tgt = tgt.Profile
	end
	if type(cur) ~= "table" or type(tgt) ~= "table" or type(cur.Radii) ~= "table" or type(tgt.Radii) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return cyl, cur, tgt, calc
end

local function newPiece(cur, tgt, calc)
	local n = math.min(cur.SliceCount, tgt.SliceCount)
	local maxGap, overcut = 0, 0
	local tol = calc.Tolerance or 0
	for i = 1, n do
		local gap = cur.Radii[i] - tgt.Radii[i]
		local need = CFG.ONLY_REDUCE and gap or math.abs(gap)
		if need > maxGap then
			maxGap = need
		end
		if -gap > tol then
			overcut += 1
		end
	end
	local speed = CFG.CARVE_SECONDS > 0 and (maxGap / CFG.CARVE_SECONDS) or math.huge
	vlog(("new log: %d slices, max cut %.3f, speed %.3f/s, already-overcut slices %d%s"):format(
		n,
		maxGap,
		speed == math.huge and 0 or speed,
		overcut,
		(overcut > 0 and CFG.ONLY_REDUCE) and " (ONLY_REDUCE=true → those stay; max accuracy < 100)" or ""
	))
	return { Cur = cur, Tgt = tgt, N = n, Speed = speed, Done = false, DoneAt = nil, Confirmed = false, Started = os.clock() }
end

local modified = {}
local function step(lathe, dt)
	local cyl, cur, tgt, calc = getProfiles(lathe)
	if not cyl then
		return
	end

	local p = state.Piece
	if not p or p.Cur ~= cur or p.Tgt ~= tgt then
		p = newPiece(cur, tgt, calc)
		state.Piece = p
		state.Accum = 0
	end
	if p.Done then
		return
	end

	-- throttle: only cut + rebuild the mesh STEP_HZ times per second
	state.Accum += dt
	local interval = 1 / math.max(1, CFG.STEP_HZ)
	if state.Accum < interval then
		return
	end
	local budget = p.Speed * state.Accum
	state.Accum = 0

	local count = 0
	local eps = cur.ChangeEpsilon or 1e-5
	table.clear(modified)
	local radii, tradii = cur.Radii, tgt.Radii
	for i = 1, p.N do
		local r, t = radii[i], tradii[i]
		local nr
		if r > t then
			nr = math.max(t, r - budget)
		elseif r < t and not CFG.ONLY_REDUCE then
			nr = math.min(t, r + budget)
		end
		if nr then
			if cur:SetRadius(i, nr) then
				count += 1
				modified[count] = i
			elseif math.abs(nr - t) <= eps then
				radii[i] = t -- snap the last sub-epsilon bit so it equals the target exactly
			end
		end
	end

	if count > 0 then
		pcall(cyl.UpdateSlices, cyl, modified, count)
		lathe.HasModifiedWood = true
		return
	end

	-- nothing left to cut → done
	p.Done = true
	p.DoneAt = os.clock()
	local res = calc:Calculate()
	local msg = ("log finished in %.1fs: accuracy %.2f%% (max %.2f%%, progress %.4f, overcut slices %d)"):format(
		p.DoneAt - p.Started,
		res.Accuracy,
		res.MaximumAccuracy,
		res.Progress,
		math.floor(res.RuinedSliceFraction * res.SliceCount + 0.5)
	)
	log(msg)
	if setclipboard then
		pcall(setclipboard, TAG .. " " .. msg)
	end
end

local function tryAutoConfirm()
	local p = state.Piece
	if not (CFG.AUTO_CONFIRM and p and p.Done and not p.Confirmed and p.DoneAt) then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - p.DoneAt < CFG.AUTO_CONFIRM_DELAY then
		return
	end
	local c = state.Carving
	if not c or type(c.CompleteLatheWork) ~= "function" or c.SavePending then
		return
	end
	p.Confirmed = true
	log("auto-confirm → CompleteLatheWork()")
	local ok, err = pcall(c.CompleteLatheWork, c)
	if not ok then
		warn(TAG, "CompleteLatheWork failed:", err)
	end
end

local function tick(lathe, dt)
	if not state.Enabled or not lathe then
		return
	end
	if state.Lathe ~= lathe then
		state.Lathe = lathe
		state.Piece = nil
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(step, lathe, dt)
	if not ok then
		warn(TAG, "step error:", err)
	end
	tryAutoConfirm()
end

-- ── 1) hook the game's own frame functions ─────────────────────────────────
local function findModule(name, parentName)
	local roots = { game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst") }
	local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
	local ps = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerScripts")
	if ps then
		table.insert(roots, ps)
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
		for _, d in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
			if d.Name == name and d:IsA("ModuleScript") and (not parentName or (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name == parentName)) then
				return d
			end
		end
	end
end

local function hookMethod(class, key, wrap)
	local orig = rawget(class, key)
	if type(orig) ~= "function" then
		return false
	end
	local hooked = wrap(orig)
	rawset(class, key, hooked)
	table.insert(state.Unhooks, function()
		if rawget(class, key) == hooked then
			rawset(class, key, orig)
		end
	end)
	return true
end

local hookedLathe, hookedCarving = false, false
do
	local lcMod = findModule("LatheController", "WoodCarving")
	local wcMod = lcMod and lcMod.Parent
	if lcMod then
		local ok, LC = pcall(require, lcMod)
		if ok and type(LC) == "table" and type(rawget(LC, "UpdateActiveTool")) == "function" then
			hookedLathe = hookMethod(LC, "Update", function(orig)
				return function(self, dt, ...)
					local r = table.pack(orig(self, dt, ...))
					state.LastHookCall = os.clock()
					tick(self, dt or 0)
					return table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
				end
			end)
		else
			vlog("require(LatheController) failed:", ok and typeof(LC) or LC)
		end
	end
	if wcMod and wcMod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, WC = pcall(require, wcMod)
		if ok and type(WC) == "table" and type(rawget(WC, "CompleteLatheWork")) == "function" then
			hookedCarving = hookMethod(WC, "RenderStep", function(orig)
				return function(self, ...)
					state.Carving = self
					return orig(self, ...)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	log(("hooks: LatheController.Update=%s WoodCarving.RenderStep=%s"):format(tostring(hookedLathe), tostring(hookedCarving)))
end

-- ── 2) fallback: single scan per lathe entry, triggered by the ghost mesh ──
local function scanOnce()
	local lathe, carving
	for _, t in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
		if type(t) == "table" then
			if not lathe and rawget(t, "ToolCarriage") ~= nil and rawget(t, "CarvingTool") ~= nil and rawget(t, "Destroyed") ~= true then
				lathe = t
			elseif not carving and type(rawget(t, "Lathe")) == "table" and rawget(t, "LatheSessionId") ~= nil then
				carving = t
			end
			if lathe and carving then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return lathe, carving
end

local fallbackLathe = nil
local function onGhost()
	-- give the hook a moment; only scan if it isn't delivering frames
	task.delay(1.5, function()
		if os.clock() - state.LastHookCall < 1 then
			return
		end
		local l, c = scanOnce()
		vlog("fallback scan:", l and "lathe found" or "no lathe", c and "+ carving client" or "")
		fallbackLathe = l
		if c then
			state.Carving = c
		end
	end)
end

table.insert(state.Conns, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
	if d.Name == "TargetGhostMesh" then
		onGhost()
	end
end))
if workspace:FindFirstChild("TargetGhostMesh", true) then
	onGhost()
end

table.insert(state.Conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if not fallbackLathe then
		return
	end
	if fallbackLathe.Destroyed or os.clock() - state.LastHookCall < 1 then
		fallbackLathe = nil -- lathe closed, or the hook took over
		return
	end
	tick(fallbackLathe, dt)
end))

-- ── toggle / lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
table.insert(state.Conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or input.KeyCode ~= CFG.TOGGLE_KEY then
		return
	end
	state.Enabled = not state.Enabled
	state.Piece = nil
	log(state.Enabled and "ENABLED" or "DISABLED")
end))

G.__WCPerfect = {
	State = state,
	Config = CFG,
	Stop = function()
		for _, c in ipairs(state.Conns) do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
		for _, u in ipairs(state.Unhooks) do
			pcall(u)
		end
		table.clear(state.Conns)
		table.clear(state.Unhooks)
		log("stopped")
	end,
}

log(("loaded. CARVE_SECONDS=%s STEP_HZ=%s ONLY_REDUCE=%s AUTO_CONFIRM=%s toggle=%s — sit at the lathe."):format(
	tostring(CFG.CARVE_SECONDS),
	tostring(CFG.STEP_HZ),
	tostring(CFG.ONLY_REDUCE),
	tostring(CFG.AUTO_CONFIRM),
	CFG.TOGGLE_KEY.Name
))

local originals     = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local partKeyOf     = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local partGroupOf   = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local rainbowT, rainbowColor = 0, Color3.fromHSV(0, 1, 1)

local function stripTexture(p, force)
	if not CONFIG.STRIP_TEXTURES then return end
	local o = originals[p]
	if not o then return end
	if o.stripped and not force then return end
	o.stripped = true
	for _, ch in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
		if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			o.sa = o.sa or {}
			table.insert(o.sa, ch)
			ch.Parent = nil
		end
	end
	if p:IsA("MeshPart") and p.TextureID ~= "" then
		o.tex = p.TextureID
		pcall(function() p.TextureID = "" end)
	end
end

local function restoreTexture(p)
	local o = originals[p]
	if not o or not o.stripped then return end
	o.stripped = false
	if o.sa then
		for _, sa in ipairs(o.sa) do
			pcall(function() sa.Parent = p end)
		end
		o.sa = nil
	end
	if o.tex then
		local t = o.tex
		pcall(function() p.TextureID = t end)
		o.tex = nil
	end
end

local function sameColor(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.R - b.R) < 0.002 and math.abs(a.G - b.G) < 0.002 and math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 0.002
end

local function desiredColor(p)
	if rainbow.All then
		return Color3.fromHSV((rainbowT + (phaseOf[p] or 0)) % 1, 1, 1)
	end
	local pk = partKeyOf[p]
	local pc = pk and state.partColors[pk]
	if pc then return pc end
	local g = partGroupOf[p]
	if g then
		if rainbow[g] then return rainbowColor end
		return state.colors[g]
	end
	return nil
end

local function desiredMaterial(p)
	local g = partGroupOf[p]
	return g and state.materials[g] or nil
end

local function enforcePart(p)
	if not p.Parent then return end
	local want = desiredColor(p)
	if want then
		local o = originals[p]
		if o and not o.stripped then stripTexture(p) end
		if p:IsA("UnionOperation") and not p.UsePartColor then p.UsePartColor = true end
		if not sameColor(p.Color, want) then p.Color = want end
	end
	local m = desiredMaterial(p)
	if m and p.Material ~= m then p.Material = m end
end

local function hasPaint()
	return next(state.colors) ~= nil or next(state.materials) ~= nil
		or next(state.partColors) ~= nil or next(rainbow) ~= nil
end

local function enforceAll()
	if not hasPaint() then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(allParts) do enforcePart(p) end
end

-- вернуть всё в заводское и накатить текущее состояние заново
local function repaintAll()
	for _, p in ipairs(allParts) do
		local o = originals[p]
		if o and p.Parent then
			restoreTexture(p)
			if not sameColor(p.Color, o.Color) then p.Color = o.Color end
			if p.Material ~= o.Material then p.Material = o.Material end
			if o.UsePartColor ~= nil and p:IsA("UnionOperation") then p.UsePartColor = o.UsePartColor end
		end
	end
	enforceAll()
end

local function hookPart(p)
	if hooked[p] then return end
	hooked[p] = true
	local function recheck()
		if p.Parent and not rainbow.All then enforcePart(p) end
	end
	p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"):Connect(recheck)
	p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Material"):Connect(recheck)
	p.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
		if ch:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") and desiredColor(p) then
			stripTexture(p, true)
		end
	end)
	if p:IsA("MeshPart") then
		p:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TextureID"):Connect(function()
			if desiredColor(p) and p.TextureID ~= "" then stripTexture(p, true) end
		end)
	end
end

local lastSearch = -100

local function isFx(obj)
	return obj.Name:sub(1, 5) == "GIGA_" or obj:FindFirstAncestor("GIGA_FX") ~= nil
end

local function classify(part)
	for _, g in ipairs(GROUP_ORDER) do
		for _, n in ipairs(PART_NAMES[g]) do
			if part.Name == n then return g end
		end
	end
	local node = part
	while node and node ~= scooter do
		local ln = node.Name:lower()
		for _, g in ipairs(GROUP_ORDER) do
			for _, kw in ipairs(KEYWORDS[g]) do
				if ln:find(kw, 1, true) then return g end
			end
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local function relPath(p)
	local names = {}
	local node = p
	while node and node ~= scooter do
		table.insert(names, 1, node.Name)
		node = node.Parent
	end
	if #names == 0 then return p.Name end
	return table.concat(names, "/")
end

local function normName(n)
	return (n:lower():gsub("[^%w]", ""))
end

local function searchScooter()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastSearch < 2 then return nil end
	lastSearch = now
	local s = Workspace:FindFirstChild(CONFIG.SCOOTER_NAME, true)
	if s then return s end
	local needle = normName(CONFIG.SCOOTER_NAME)
	for _, d in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local n = normName(d.Name)
			if n == needle or n:find("kukirin", 1, true) then return d end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function pickNearest(list)
	if #list <= 1 then return list[1] end
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return list[1] end
	local best, bd = nil, math.huge
	for _, s in ipairs(list) do
		local pos = s:IsA("Model") and s:GetPivot().Position or s.Position
		local d = (pos - hrp.Position).Magnitude
		if d < bd then best, bd = s, d end
	end
	return best
end

local function directCandidates()
	local list = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if c.Name == CONFIG.SCOOTER_NAME and (c:IsA("Model") or c:IsA("BasePart")) then
			table.insert(list, c)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function getScooter()
	local s = scooter
	-- если ты сидишь в самокате — это и есть наш самокат
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart
	local ridden = seat and seat:FindFirstAncestor(CONFIG.SCOOTER_NAME)
	if ridden and ridden ~= scooter and (ridden:IsA("Model") or ridden:IsA("BasePart")) then
		s = ridden
	elseif not (s and s:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)) then
		s = pickNearest(directCandidates()) or searchScooter()
	end
	if s ~= scooter then
		scooter = s
		dirty = true
		if descConn then descConn:Disconnect() descConn = nil end
		if s then
			descConn = s.DescendantAdded:Connect(function() dirty = true end)
		end
	end
	return scooter
end

local function rescan()
	for _, g in ipairs(GROUP_ORDER) do groups[g] = {} end
	unclassified, allParts, partsByKey, keyList = {}, {}, {}, {}
	rootPart = nil
	scanVersion += 1
	local s = scooter
	if not s then
		if updateStatus then updateStatus() end
		return
	end
	local biggest, biggestVol = nil, 0
	local list = s:GetDescendants()
	if s:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list, s) end
	for _, obj in ipairs(list) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not isFx(obj) then
			if not originals[obj] then
				local entry = {Color = obj.Color, Material = obj.Material, Transparency = obj.Transparency}
				if obj:IsA("UnionOperation") then entry.UsePartColor = obj.UsePartColor end
				originals[obj] = entry
			end
			hookPart(obj)
			local g = classify(obj)
			partGroupOf[obj] = g
			if g then table.insert(groups[g], obj) else table.insert(unclassified, obj) end
			table.insert(allParts, obj)
			local key = relPath(obj)
			partKeyOf[obj] = key
			local bucket = partsByKey[key]
			if not bucket then
				bucket = {}
				partsByKey[key] = bucket
				table.insert(keyList, key)
			end
			table.insert(bucket, obj)
			local vol = obj.Size.X * obj.Size.Y * obj.Size.Z
			if vol > biggestVol then biggest, biggestVol = obj, vol end
		end
	end
	table.sort(keyList)
	if s:IsA("Model") and s.PrimaryPart then
		rootPart = s.PrimaryPart
	else
		rootPart = biggest
	end
	if CONFIG.UNCLASSIFIED_TO_FRAME and #groups.Frame == 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(unclassified) do
			table.insert(groups.Frame, p)
			partGroupOf[p] = "Frame"
		end
	end

	-- фаза радуги: позиция детали вдоль самоката
	if rootPart then
		local f = CONFIG.FORWARD_LOCAL
		local dist, lo, hi = {}, math.huge, -math.huge
		for _, p in ipairs(allParts) do
			local v = rootPart.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position):Dot(f)
			dist[p] = v
			if v < lo then lo = v end
			if v > hi then hi = v end
		end
		local span = math.max(hi - lo, 0.001)
		for p, v in pairs(dist) do
			phaseOf[p] = (v - lo) / span * CONFIG.RAINBOW_SPREAD
		end
	end

	-- новые/пересозданные детали красим сразу же
	enforceAll()
	if updateStatus then updateStatus() end
end

local function isRiding()
	local s = scooter
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not (s and char and hrp) then return false end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local seat = hum and hum.SeatPart
	if seat and seat:IsDescendantOf(s) then return true end
	local root = rootPart
	if not root then return false end
	local ok, parts = pcall(function() return root:GetConnectedParts(true) end)
	if ok then
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
			if p:IsDescendantOf(char) then return true end
		end
	end
	return (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= CONFIG.RIDE_RADIUS
end

local function resetFreezeState()
	freeze.on = false
	freeze.saved = {}
	if freezeToggleUI then freezeToggleUI.set(false) end
end

-- возвращает true, если состояние стало таким, как просили
local function setFreeze(on)
	if on == freeze.on then return true end
	if on then
		ensure()
		if not rootPart or not isRiding() then return false end
		freeze.saved = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(allParts) do
			if p.Parent then
				freeze.saved[p] = p.Anchored
				p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				p.Anchored = true
			end
		end
		freeze.on = true
	else
		for p, was in pairs(freeze.saved) do
			if p.Parent then p.Anchored = was end
		end
		freeze.saved = {}
		freeze.on = false
	end
	if freezeToggleUI then freezeToggleUI.set(freeze.on) end
	return true
end

local function checkFreeze()
	local hum = getHumanoid()
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not hrp or not rootPart
		or (hrp.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude > 40 then
		setFreeze(false)
	end
end

local function newBarPart(folder, root, localCF, size)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = "WheelieBar"
	p.Size = size
	p.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	p.Color = RGB(28, 28, 30)
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.CanCollide = CONFIG.WHEELIE_BAR_COLLIDE
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.Massless = true
	p.CFrame = root.CFrame * localCF
	p.Parent = folder
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = root
	w.Part1 = p
	w.Parent = p
	return p
end

local function buildWheelieBar()
	ensure()
	local root, s = rootPart, scooter
	if not root or not s then return false end
	local old = s:FindFirstChild("WheelieBarAdded")
	if old then old:Destroy() end

	local fwd = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(CONFIG.FORWARD_LOCAL)
	local rear = getRearWheel(fwd)
	local back = -CONFIG.FORWARD_LOCAL.Unit
	local side = CONFIG.FORWARD_LOCAL:Cross(Vector3.yAxis).Unit
	local center, r, halfW
	if rear then
		center = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(rear.Position)
		r = math.max(rear.Size.X, rear.Size.Y, rear.Size.Z) / 2
		halfW = math.min(rear.Size.X, rear.Size.Y, rear.Size.Z) / 2 + 0.2
	else
		center = back * (math.max(root.Size.X, root.Size.Z) / 2) + Vector3.new(0, -root.Size.Y / 2 + 0.4, 0)
		r, halfW = 0.4, 0.4
	end

	local t = math.clamp(r * 0.18, 0.06, 0.2)
	local a = center + back * (r * 0.4) + Vector3.new(0, r * 0.35, 0)
	local b = center + back * (r * 1.9) + Vector3.new(0, -r * 0.6, 0)

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "WheelieBarAdded"
	folder.Parent = s

	for _, sgn in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
		local A = a + side * (sgn * halfW)
		local B = b + side * (sgn * halfW)
		local len = (B - A).Magnitude
		newBarPart(folder, root, CFrame.lookAt((A + B) / 2, B), Vector3.new(t, t, len))
	end
	newBarPart(folder, root, CFrame.lookAt(b, b + side), Vector3.new(t * 1.4, t * 1.4, halfW * 2 + t))

	dirty = true -- пересканируем: новые детали попадут в группу WheelieBar и сразу покрасятся
	return true
end

local function localBounds(root, model)
	local minV = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	local maxV = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
	local list = model:GetDescendants()
	if model:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list, model) end
	for _, p in ipairs(list) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") and not isFx(p) then
			local rel = root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
			local h = p.Size / 2
			for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
				for _, sy in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
					for _, sz in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
						local c = rel * Vector3.new(h.X * sx, h.Y * sy, h.Z * sz)
						minV = Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X, c.X), math.min(minV.Y, c.Y), math.min(minV.Z, c.Z))
						maxV = Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X, c.X), math.max(maxV.Y, c.Y), math.max(maxV.Z, c.Z))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return minV, maxV
end

local function buildGlow()
	destroyGlow()
	if not state.underglow then return end
	local root = getRoot()
	local folder = getFxFolder()
	if not root or not folder then return end

	local minV, maxV = localBounds(root, scooter)

local function setWheelie(on)

	if wheelieToggleUI then wheelieToggleUI.set(on) end

local function stepWheelie(dt)
	local goal = wheelie.on and CONFIG.WHEELIE_ANGLE or 0
	local maxStep = CONFIG.WHEELIE_RAMP * dt
	wheelie.target = wheelie.target + math.clamp(goal - wheelie.target, -maxStep, maxStep)
	if not wheelie.on and wheelie.target < 0.05 then
		wheelie.target = 0
		return
	end

	local root = getRoot()
	if not root or root.Anchored then return end

	local fwd = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(CONFIG.FORWARD_LOCAL).Unit
	local right = fwd:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
	if right.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
	right = right.Unit

	local pitch = math.deg(math.asin(math.clamp(fwd.Y, -1, 1)))
	local err = wheelie.target - pitch

	local rate = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity:Dot(right)
	local want = math.clamp(math.rad(err) * CONFIG.WHEELIE_POWER, -4, 4)
	local newRate = rate + (want - rate) * math.clamp(dt * 12, 0, 1)
	local dW = right * (newRate - rate)

	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity + dW

	-- вращаем вокруг оси заднего колеса, чтобы оно не вдавливалось в землю
	local rear = getRearWheel(fwd)
	if rear then
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			+ dW:Cross(root.AssemblyCenterOfMass - rear.Position)
	end
end

local hex, encodeKey, decodeKey, captureData, applyData
do
function hex(c)
	return string.format("%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
end

local function unhex(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" or #s ~= 6 then return nil end
	local r, g, b = tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16)
	if r and g and b then return RGB(r, g, b) end
	return nil
end

local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_"
local B64IDX = {}
for i = 1, #B64 do B64IDX[B64:byte(i)] = i - 1 end

local function b64enc(s)
	local out, n = {}, 0
	for i = 1, #s, 3 do
		local a, b, c = s:byte(i, i + 2)
		local v = a * 65536 + (b or 0) * 256 + (c or 0)
		local c1 = bit32.rshift(v, 18) % 64
		local c2 = bit32.rshift(v, 12) % 64
		local c3 = bit32.rshift(v, 6) % 64
		local c4 = v % 64
		local piece = B64:sub(c1 + 1, c1 + 1) .. B64:sub(c2 + 1, c2 + 1)
		if b then piece = piece .. B64:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1) end
		if c then piece = piece .. B64:sub(c4 + 1, c4 + 1) end
		n += 1
		out[n] = piece
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function b64dec(s)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #s, 4 do
		local chunk = s:sub(i, i + 3)
		local cnt = #chunk
		if cnt == 1 then return nil end
		local v = 0
		for j = 1, 4 do
			local ch = chunk:byte(j)
			local x = ch and B64IDX[ch]
			if ch and not x then return nil end
			v = v * 64 + (x or 0)
		end
		table.insert(out, string.char(bit32.rshift(v, 16) % 256))
		if cnt >= 3 then table.insert(out, string.char(bit32.rshift(v, 8) % 256)) end
		if cnt == 4 then table.insert(out, string.char(v % 256)) end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local KEY_PREFIX = "GM1"

local function checksum(s)
	local h = 7
	for i = 1, #s do h = (h * 31 + s:byte(i)) % 65521 end
	return string.format("%04x", h)
end

function encodeKey(d)
	local ok, json = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(d) end)
	if not ok then return nil end
	local payload = b64enc(json)
	return KEY_PREFIX .. "." .. payload .. "." .. checksum(payload)
end

function decodeKey(key)
	key = (tostring(key or ""):gsub("%s+", ""))
	if key == "" then return nil, "empty" end
	if #key > 40000 then return nil, "too long" end
	local prefix, payload, sum = key:match("^(%w+)%.([%w%-_]+)%.(%x+)$")
	if prefix ~= KEY_PREFIX then return nil, "wrong format" end
	if checksum(payload) ~= sum then return nil, "key is damaged" end
	local json = b64dec(payload)
	if not json then return nil, "bad data" end
	local ok, d = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(json) end)
	if not ok or type(d) ~= "table" then return nil, "bad data" end
	return d
end

-- снимок текущей темы
function captureData(name)
	local d = {v = 1, n = name, c = {}, m = {}, p = {}}
	for g, c in pairs(state.colors) do d.c[g] = hex(c) end
	for g, m in pairs(state.materials) do d.m[g] = m.Name end
	for k, c in pairs(state.partColors) do d.p[k] = hex(c) end
	d.g, d.go = hex(state.glowColor), state.underglow and 1 or 0
	d.t, d.to = hex(state.trailColor), state.trail and 1 or 0
	if state.smokeColor then d.s = hex(state.smokeColor) end
	if rainbow.All then d.r = 1 end
	return d
end

-- применить тему из данных (всё остальное сбрасывается в заводское)
function applyData(d)
	for k in pairs(rainbow) do rainbow[k] = nil end
	state.colors, state.materials, state.partColors = {}, {}, {}

	if type(d.c) == "table" then
		for g, h in pairs(d.c) do
			local c = unhex(h)
			if c and GROUP_SET[g] then state.colors[g] = c end
		end
	end
	if type(d.m) == "table" then
		for g, n in pairs(d.m) do
			local ok, m = pcall(function() return Enum.Material[n] end)
			if ok and m and GROUP_SET[g] then state.materials[g] = m end
		end
	end
	if type(d.p) == "table" then
		for k, h in pairs(d.p) do
			local c = unhex(h)
			if c and type(k) == "string" then state.partColors[k] = c end
		end
	end

	local gc = unhex(d.g)
	if gc then state.glowColor = gc end
	if d.go ~= nil then state.underglow = (d.go == 1) end
	local tc = unhex(d.t)
	if tc then state.trailColor = tc end
	if d.to ~= nil then state.trail = (d.to == 1) end
	state.smokeColor = unhex(d.s)
	if d.r == 1 then rainbow.All = true end

	repaintAll()
	buildGlow()
	buildTrail()
	if state.smokeColor then setSmokeColor(state.smokeColor) else restoreSmoke() end
	syncUI()
end

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)

	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
	connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)

-- слайдер 0..255 (как R/G/B в видео)
local function makeSlider(parent, position, size, initial, fillColor, onChange, scrollFrame)
	local hit = new("Frame", {Position = position, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true}, parent)
	local bar = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.track, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, hit)
	corner(bar, 3)
	local fill = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = fillColor, BorderSizePixel = 0}, bar)
	corner(fill, 3)
	local knob = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
		BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
	}, bar)
	corner(knob, 6)

	local function visual(v)
		local a = math.clamp(v / 255, 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
	end
	visual(initial)

	local dragging = false
	local function update(x)
		local a = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		local v = math.floor(a * 255 + 0.5)
		visual(v)
		onChange(v)
	end
	local function lock(l)
		if scrollFrame then scrollFrame.ScrollingEnabled = not l end
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			lock(true)
			update(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			update(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			dragging = false
			lock(false)
		end
	end)

	return {set = function(v) visual(v) end}
end

-- три слайдера R/G/B внутри panel; onChange вызывается только когда двигает пользователь
local CHANS = {{"R", RGB(240, 80, 84)}, {"G", RGB(80, 250, 81)}, {"B", RGB(83, 80, 238)}}
local function makeRGBSliders(panel, page, onChange, startOrder)
	local draft = {255, 255, 255}
	local sliders, labels = {}, {}
	for i, ch in ipairs(CHANS) do
		local line = new("Frame", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = startOrder + i - 1}, panel)
		new("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = ch[1], TextColor3 = ch[2],
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 10,
		}, line)
		labels[i] = new("TextLabel", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 18),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "255", TextColor3 = C.dim, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 10,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		}, line)
		sliders[i] = makeSlider(line, UDim2.fromOffset(20, 0), UDim2.new(1, -56, 1, 0), 255, ch[2], function(v)
			draft[i] = v
			labels[i].Text = tostring(v)
			onChange(RGB(draft[1], draft[2], draft[3]))
		end, page)
	end
	return {
		get = function() return RGB(draft[1], draft[2], draft[3]) end,
		set = function(c)
			draft = {math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)}
			for i = 1, 3 do
				sliders[i].set(draft[i])
				labels[i].Text = tostring(draft[i])
			end
		end,
	}
end

for typeName, data in pairs(BallTypes) do

        end
        if thrownBall then
            thrownBall.Color = data.Color

        end

changeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

local function playSound(id, parent, volume)
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.SoundId = id
    s.Volume = volume or 2
    s.Parent = parent
    s:Play()
    Debris:AddItem(s, 4)
end

local function addBallVFX(ball, typeName)
    local data = BallTypes[typeName]
    local light = Instance.new("PointLight", ball)
    light.Color = data.LightColor
    light.Range = 15
    light.Brightness = 3
    light.Shadows = true
    if typeName == "Flame" then
        local f = Instance.new("Fire", ball) f.Size=12 f.Heat=10
        local sm = Instance.new("Smoke", ball) sm.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,100,0) sm.RiseVelocity=2 sm.Size=5
    elseif typeName == "Light" then
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", ball)
        pe.Texture="rbxassetid://1084965043" pe.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,150)) pe.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.5) pe.Rate=150 pe.Speed=NumberRange.new(5) pe.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
    elseif typeName == "Lightning" then
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", ball)
        pe.Texture="rbxassetid://241650881" pe.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255)) pe.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.3) pe.Rate=200 pe.Speed=NumberRange.new(0)
    elseif typeName == "Magma" then
        Instance.new("Fire", ball).Size=15
        local sm = Instance.new("Smoke", ball) sm.Color=Color3.fromRGB(50,10,0) sm.Size=8
    elseif typeName == "Galaxy" or typeName=="Blackhole" or typeName=="Dragon" then
        local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", ball)
        pe.Texture="rbxassetid://1095708" pe.Color=ColorSequence.new(data.LightColor) pe.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(1) pe.Rate=100 pe.Speed=NumberRange.new(3)
    end
end

local function applyEffect(pos, model, ballType)
    if not model or not model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return end
    if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) or model == player.Character then return end
    local data = BallTypes[ballType]
    if ballType == "Light" then
        playSound(data.SoundHit, model.HumanoidRootPart, 3)
        for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,150), Material=Enum.Material.Neon}):Play() local hl=Instance.new("Highlight", v) hl.FillColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0) hl.FillTransparency=0.2 end end
        task.wait(0.6)
        for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then TweenService:Create(v, TweenInfo.new(1), {Transparency=1}):Play() end end
        task.wait(1) model:Destroy()
    elseif ballType == "Ice" then
        playSound(data.SoundHit, model.HumanoidRootPart, 3)
        for _,v in pairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Anchored=true v.Color=Color3.fromRGB(100,200,255) v.Material=Enum.Material.Ice end end
        task.wait(1.5) model.Humanoid.Health=0
    elseif ballType == "Blackhole" then
        playSound(data.SoundHit, workspace, 5)
        local hole=Instance.new("Part",workspace) hole.Anchored=true hole.CanCollide=false hole.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball hole.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1) hole.CFrame=CFrame.new(pos) hole.Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0) hole.Material=Enum.Material.ForceField
        TweenService:Create(hole, TweenInfo.new(1), {Size=Vector3.new(20,20,20)}):Play()
        for _,v in pairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(pos,30)) do local m=v.Parent if m and m:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) and m~=player.Character then local hrp=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if hrp then TweenService:Create(hrp,TweenInfo.new(0.8),{CFrame=CFrame.new(pos)}):Play() task.delay(0.9,function() if m.Parent then m.Humanoid.Health=0 end end) end end end
        Debris:AddItem(hole,2)
    else
        playSound(data.SoundHit, model.HumanoidRootPart, 3)
        local exp=Instance.new("Explosion",workspace) exp.BlastRadius=14 exp.BlastPressure=0 exp.Position=pos exp.DestroyJointRadiusPercent=0
        model.Humanoid.Health=0
    end
end

local function createTool()
    if player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("ThorBall")) then return end
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "ThorBall"
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.CanBeDropped = false
    local handle = Instance.new("Part")
    handle.Name = "Handle"
    handle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(2.8,2.8,2.8)
    handle.Color = BallTypes[getgenv().SelectedBallType].Color
    handle.Material = BallTypes[getgenv().SelectedBallType].Material
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.Massless = true
    handle.Parent = tool
    Instance.new("SpecialMesh", handle).MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
    tool.Parent = player.Backpack

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        changeBtn.Visible = true
    end)
    tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
        changeBtn.Visible = false
        selectorFrame.Visible = false
    end)
end

local function makeFloat(ball)
    local att = Instance.new("Attachment", ball)
    local force = Instance.new("VectorForce", ball)
    force.Attachment0 = att
    force.Force = Vector3.new(0, ball:GetMass() * workspace.Gravity, 0)
    force.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    force.Parent = ball
    ball.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0,5,0)

    if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
    -- NO SLOW DOWN FLOAT, keep Y level
    floatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not ball or not ball.Parent or isReturning then return end
        -- keep same Y, no drop
        local vel = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        -- only correct Y, keep X,Z speed same
        if math.abs(vel.Y) > 1 then
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, vel.Y * 0.99, vel.Z)
        else
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        end
        -- enforce constant speed
        if ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < lastSpeed - 5 then
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Unit * lastSpeed
        end
    end)
end

local function throwBall()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    if thrownBall then thrownBall:Destroy() end
    if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
    if char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") then char.ThorBall.Handle.Transparency = 1 end

    local typeData = BallTypes[getgenv().SelectedBallType]
    lastSpeed = typeData.Speed
    local ball = Instance.new("Part")
    ball.Name = "ThorBall_Thrown"
    ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    ball.Size = Vector3.new(3.2,3.2,3.2)
    ball.Color = typeData.Color
    ball.Material = typeData.Material
    ball.CanCollide = true
    ball.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.1, 1, 0, 1, 1) -- Elasticity 1 = NO SLOW DOWN
    ball.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,1.5,-4)
    ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * typeData.Speed
    ball.Parent = workspace
    thrownBall = ball

    makeFloat(ball)
    addBallVFX(ball, getgenv().SelectedBallType)
    playSound(typeData.SoundThrow, ball, 2)

    local trail = Instance.new("Trail", ball)
    trail.Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment", ball)
    trail.Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", ball)
    trail.Attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0,0.5,0)
    trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(typeData.Trail)
    trail.Lifetime = 0.7

    local debounce=false
    ball.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        if isReturning or not hit then return end
        if hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
        local model=hit.Parent
        -- DAMAGE CHECK FIRST
        if model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
            if debounce then return end
            debounce=true
            local expl=Instance.new("Explosion",workspace) expl.BlastRadius=8 expl.BlastPressure=0 expl.Position=ball.Position expl.DestroyJointRadiusPercent=0
            applyEffect(ball.Position, model, getgenv().SelectedBallType)
            if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
            ball:Destroy() thrownBall=nil
            if char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") then char.ThorBall.Handle.Transparency=0 end
            return
        end

        -- BOUNCE WITH NO SLOW DOWN
        if not debounce then
            local normal = (ball.Position - hit.Position).Unit
            local vel = ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local dot = vel:Dot(normal)
            local reflected = vel - (2 * dot * normal)
            -- KEEP SAME SPEED
            ball.AssemblyLinearVelocity = reflected.Unit * lastSpeed
            playSound("rbxassetid://12222030", ball, 1)
        end
    end)
    Debris:AddItem(ball, 30)
end

local function returnBall()
    if not thrownBall or isReturning then return end
    isReturning=true
    if floatConn then floatConn:Disconnect() end
    playSound("rbxassetid://12222124", thrownBall, 3)
    thrownBall.CanCollide=false
    thrownBall.Anchored=true
    local char=player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then isReturning=false return end
    local tween=TweenService:Create(thrownBall, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {CFrame=char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.5,-4)})
    tween:Play() tween.Completed:Wait()
    if thrownBall then thrownBall:Destroy() thrownBall=nil end
    if char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall") then char.ThorBall.Handle.Transparency=0 end
    isReturning=false
end

ballBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(createTool)
returnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(returnBall)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char=player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local t=char:FindFirstChild("ThorBall")
    if t and not t:FindFirstChild("ActivatedConn") then
        local c=Instance.new("BoolValue", t) c.Name="ActivatedConn"
        t.Activated:Connect(function() if not thrownBall then throwBall() end end)
    end
end)
createTool()
]])()

1. Aim & Tracking

• Smooth Mouse Movement — Moves your mouse naturally without snapping, camera glitches, or screen shaking.

• Framerate-Independent Smoothing — Keeps your aim completely smooth whether you play on 60, 144, or 240+ FPS.

• Hitbox Selector — Quickly switch between aiming at the Head or Body (Torso).

• Target Lock (Anti-Jitter) — Stays locked on your current target instead of spazzing out when enemies stand close together.

• Aim Key Types — Choose between Holding Right Click or using a Toggle key.

2. TriggerBot

• 3 Trigger Modes:

- Always On: Automatically shoots the instant an enemy enters your crosshair.

- Hold Right Click: Only fires when you hold Right Mouse Button.

- Scoped Only: Only fires when fully zoomed in with a sniper or scoped gun.

• Perfect Quickscope Timing — Waits for your sniper zoom animation to settle so your quickscopes never miss due to hipfire spread.

• Clean Hit Registration — Ignores hats, accessories, dropped weapons, and transparent map clutter to only hit real body parts.

• Humanized Delays — Customizable shot delays and burst controls to keep your shooting natural and avoid looking obvious.

3. Smart Team & Visibility Checks

• Advanced Team Check — Accurately detects allies vs enemies across all game modes (including FFA, custom team folders, and green outlines) so you never shoot teammates.

• Zero-Lag Performance — Optimized background checks keep your game running at a smooth 150+ FPS without frame drops.

• Wall Check — Makes sure enemies are actually visible before locking or shooting through walls.

4. Menu & Controls

• Sleek Draggable Menu — Clean dark-mode UI that you can open and close anytime with [F5].

• Smart Settings Display — Only shows sniper settings when Scoped mode is selected, keeping the menu clean and clutter-free.

• Quick Mode Swap [X] — Tap [X] to instantly switch between Aimbot and TriggerBot without opening the menu.

• Auto-Save Config — Automatically saves your custom setup to a config file so your settings stay saved every time you play.
